title: The Last Letter
text: A letter, sealed, addressed to your House in a careful hand, in the satchel of a body that is not one of yours. A courier, dead in the ditch with arrows in his back. He was carrying it for a Lost Scion, and he very nearly made it.

options.label: Break the seal and read it.

outcomes.text: Where they are, and how long they can hold, and how afraid they are.
Honor kept, and the weight of not knowing.

options.label: The healer tends the courier's body for burial.

outcomes.text: In his pocket, a second letter, and a way to find them sooner.
